row.title: Slice W02 of the specification run's code and tests shipped on its own
row.body: The describe, doors, elicit and fleet modules. Where main and the run had each built the same requirement (US-11-R12 staggering, US-16 section 5.3 default scoring) both are kept: stagger and staggerHourly in fleet, the prediction-table scorer and the outcome learner in elicit; unifying each pair is open work. Three tests that need later slices (walkthrough, src/console) ship with them.
